nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: Something made you wake up several times during the night. Make sure that you're not too hot or cold. Block out disturbing noises and bright lights.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Stay focused by using caffeine to your advantage. If you enjoy coffee or tea, a nice cup might hit the spot. Just stop in the early afternoon to make sure your sleep isn't jeopardized.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: Even though you might feel sleepy, some light physical exercise might be good for you - if you feel up like it.
